rows.prompt: In the clinic supply closet, a person must sort a delayed request queue. Facing a stack of bins and labels, they pause. The system generated an error notification for an item previously marked as complete, making the current task feel unreliable. They tentatively pick up a bin, their brow furrowed as they re-examine the conflicting data on the clipboard before placing it back down.

Their lips press into a thin line as they slowly shake their head and push the binder away.
